svg.text: Mausoleum hearse · Collector boss — contestant vehicle dossier
“I’ve dug a hole for everyone who’s ever raced here. Yours has been ready a while.”
A mausoleum grafted onto a 1930s hearse
A bell tolls when he summons
Raises the buried to race in the fog
A funeral hearse fused with a stone mausoleum
crypt, grave-dirt spilling from the seams, a
small bell on top, gothic and eerie, realistic
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~70k tris · PBR 4K · OVERPOWERED
